messages.en:
{07 00 00}{07 15 00}I'm not gonna lose to you!{01 00 00 05 00}

today, and I OWN it!

to be casual until you
corner 'em, then POUNCE!
{07 01 00}I'm gonna win this thing,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

olla rahulik, kuni surud
nad nurka, siis KARGA!
